data.narrative:
Wispr AI is a Series A stage AI & Software company founded by Tanay Kothari and Sahaj Garg, with $81.6M in total capital raised to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of four private companies at Series A/B stage in the same sector, supplemented by one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR), alongside eight additional private AI & Software firms for reference.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology uses the $82M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $163M. Peer-median analysis relies on four direct comparables—Reflection AI ($25.0B), Physical Intelligence ($5.6B), Black Forest Labs ($3.2B), and Field AI ($2.0B)—producing a median valuation of $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.0B to $25.0B. The significant dispersion reflects the stage heterogeneity and extreme valuation variation present in frontier AI.

Triangulating these methods supports a valuation range of $139M (low) to $5.1B (high), with a median estimate of $2.3B. The wide band reflects material uncertainty around both comparable company selection—particularly Reflection AI's $25B outlier—and appropriate stage-adjusted multiples for early-stage frontier-tech ventures. Stage clarity and clearer product revenue metrics would narrow this range materially.
